coverageNote: Yeh notes maujooda MCQs ke wazeh tareekhi saalon, ijadaat, kitabon aur waqiat se tayyar kiye gaye hain. Har adad saal nahin hota: hisaab ke numbers, software version ke naam, Quran-o-Hadith ke reference numbers aur sirf 'as of' wali tareekhein shamil nahin. Hijri saal alag rakhe gaye hain; andazan ya mukhtalif riwayat wali tareekh ka zikr usi ehtiyat ke saath hai.
